title: The Wright Brothers and Their Flying Machine
subtitle: 考点：科学探索 / glider, afford, none
passage: Orville and Wilbur Wright were brothers from the United States. They did not have much money, and they could not afford a university education. They ran a small bicycle shop, but they were also curious about flying. They read books about birds and built gliders to test their ideas.

Many people laughed at them, and none of their first gliders worked well. But the brothers did not give up. They made their own tools and even built a small wind tunnel to test different wing shapes. On 17 December 1903, Orville flew their plane for twelve seconds. It was a short flight, but it was the first powered flight with a person on board. It changed the world.
